findings.value: A converted Victorian warehouse under Shoreditch railway arches, known for the tube carriages on its roof and for gigs and club nights, which Time Out says often feature top electronic DJs.

evidence.quote: You can’t miss Village Underground thanks to the four brightly coloured, graffiti-covered tube carriages perched on its roof
Set underneath some cavernous railway arches, Village Underground is one of the city’s most atmospheric gig and club venues
a renovated turn-of-the-century warehouse in the heart of Shoreditch

findings.value: The venue says it welcomes a diverse audience and aims to be a safe space free of harassment and discrimination.

evidence.quote: We welcome diversity in our audience and work to create a safe space for everyone present
VU is a club for people to enjoy music without fear of harassment or discrimination.
which often hosts top electronic DJs and exciting up-and-coming artists

findings.value: The venue describes itself as home to clubbing and live music, with an artist or DJ most nights; its shows are usually booked by outside promoters.

evidence.quote: Home to cutting-edge culture, clubbing and live music
Most nights of the week you can catch an artist or DJ on the cusp of huge things
Shows at Village Underground are usually booked by external promoters

notes: No closure news found; the venue's own events pages list shows into late 2026. The homepage (undated) says 'For the first time, Village Underground opens its rooftop to the public.' and describes a rooftop bar with the tube carriages; the editor may want to consider it for the summary. Time Out's review is dated 16 July 2025, within the window for summary and music.
